prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.5% overall).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) negatively impacts performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) harm performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-1.7% overall).
Evidence is thin or inconsistent for new home flows, adoption redesigns, and path selection redesigns, with no clear effect seen.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +0.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Checklist Layout: Redesign the choose_path screen into a structured checklist layout to clarify available options and streamline companion selection. (why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8 seconds but a mean time of 514 seconds with a 76.2% conversion rate, indicating some users stall significantly during path selection.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a two-column layout to display pet attributes and visual previews side-by-side. (why: The adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89 seconds.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout that separates pet creation progress from essential desktop placement instructions. (why: The home stage waiting screen has high latency (mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Controls Redesign: Redesign home_intro using a spotlight layout that highlights how to interact, hide, and summon the companion desktop pet. (why: 3 support messages reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Cloud Save Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body to reassure users that signing in securely backs up their desktop pet and prevents loss. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) involves pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Technical Specs Hint: Add a hint on upload_photos specifying supported image dimensions and clear lighting recommendations. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or generating incorrect companion visuals.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Status Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications and display estimated generation remaining time on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend a mean time of 2336s on the home waiting step, and 3 users reported issues with pet visibility on launch.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Controls Guidance Copy: Add concise instructions in the home_intro body explaining how to minimize, call, and open settings for the desktop pet. (why: 3 users wrote to support confused about desktop controls and interaction options after finishing setup.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Flexible Selection Hint: Add a hint clarifying that chosen companion preferences can be changed anytime later in desktop app settings. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s, suggesting decision friction during initial selection.)
9: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Sound Alert Component: Add a sound effect component to the waiting screen that plays when companion preparation is complete. (why: Long wait times (mean 2336s) lead to users stepping away and missing when the pet is ready on their desktop.)
